goal: Prevent test framework helper errors when new tests call Taproot signature helpers with default arguments
agreement: Settled objections after the author updated the helper, but nobody has approved the PR yet
Objected that implicit default values hid parameters that should be explicit in tests (maflcko)
Suggested setting the default to None and mapping it to the default value internally (jmoik)

categories.name: tests
why: P4 because it fixes a test helper default argument that currently affects no in-tree tests
Existing functional tests pass the argument explicitly, making the fix narrow and deferrable
